assessments.reason: A current official Explomin page simultaneously uses the Villa El Milagro / Km. 22.5 Panamericana Sur formulation for formal correspondence and Panamericana Sur Km. 22 Huertos de Conchán for Sede Central. The address descriptions are reconciled as aliases of one Site.

ANA verifies an active Explomin property/warehouse-related point at Mz. B Lote 1 with authoritative UTM coordinates. The canonical Site is described as Mz. B Lote 2 / Panamericana Sur Km. 22–22.5. Lot numbering suggests geographic proximity but does not prove that Lote 1 is the same operational Site, an adjacent parcel of one complex, or a distinct Site.
